# Direct-source authentication/provenance certification

This certification candidate binds exactly one evidence occurrence `E`, target
`T`, provenance and source-of-record source `S`, and observation attempt `A`.
The profile requires the four binary relations, complete singleton target and
source populations, four independent verification claims, exact positive
controlled falsifiers, and four same-occurrence `verifies` relations.

`exact-capture/positive` is the canonical six-source direct capture and its
deterministic occurrence projection. Every witness embeds a signed, typed proof
whose captured key, signature, claims, and digest are verified before E/T/S/A
projection. The source signer is exactly grounded as `S`, registry authority is
shared by target resolution and source-of-record assignment, and capture
authority is shared by attempt binding and aggregate authentication.
`exact-binding-corpus.json` names every executed exact-binding
control, and the certification binds the exact executable runner digest so a
coordinated control-list re-digestion cannot invent a passing control.
`adequacy.json` binds the positive, mutant, profile-rejection, and exclusion
controls to the executable implementation.

The result excludes authorship, issuance, authorization, ownership, decision
authority, generic integrity, runtime truth, source discovery completeness,
freshness beyond the exact attempt, and all copied, transformed, or otherwise
derived evidence.
